class AsyncAanddReaderClient(AsyncDeviceClient):
    def __init__(
        self,
        config: Config = None,
        server_ip: str = None,
        server_port: int = None,
        logger: Any = None,
        log_level: str = "INFO",
    ):
        """
        旧版との互換インターフェース（引数）を保ったまま
        AsyncDeviceClient に api_spec, base_url を自動設定して渡すラッパ
        """
        if logger is None:
            import logging

            logging.basicConfig(level="INFO")
            logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

        if config is not None:
            server_ip = config.SERVER_IP
            server_port = config.FASTAPI_PORT

        self._logger = logger

        base_url = f"http://{server_ip}:{server_port}"
        self._base_url = base_url

        self._logger.info(f"[CLIENT] server_ip = {server_ip}")
        self._logger.info(f"[CLIENT] server_port = {server_port}")
        self._logger.info(f"[CLIENT] base_url = {base_url}")

        super().__init__(
            server_ip=server_ip,
            server_port=server_port,
            api_spec=aandd_reader_api_spec,
            base_url=base_url,
            logger=logger,
            log_level=log_level,
        )

    #
    # property style で一部メソッドを使えるようにする
    #



[ドキュメント]
    @staticmethod
    def _sync_await(coro):
        try:
            loop = asyncio.get_running_loop()
        except RuntimeError:
            loop = None

        if loop and loop.is_running():
            import nest_asyncio

            nest_asyncio.apply()
            return loop.run_until_complete(coro)
        else:
            return asyncio.run(coro)
